newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta composite index closes at record high.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta composite index closes at record high.

text.p: Jakarta composite index closed at record high on Thursday following sustained foreign buying in banking shares and some blue-chip counters, brokers said.
The composite index rose 6.31 points, or 0.90 percent, to close at 707.37 points, the all time high in the bourse.
Gainers led losers by 71 to 36, with 62 counters unchanged.

Turnover was 610.5 billion rupiah on a volume of 231.8 million shares. Brokers remained confident for the index to stay in the record zone although profit-taking might emerge soon as share prices had risen very fast in the past few days.
"Overall sentiment remains upbeat although some investors might cash out first on Friday," one Singaporean broker said.
Brokers also pointed the sharp overnight rise in the Dow Jones average to be helpful to Thursday's market sentiment.
Blue-chip Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) was likely to remain the focus on Friday on intensive market talk of a possible inclusion in the Morgan Stanley Capital Index, brokers said.
They said it was rumoured an announcement would be made on February 15. But confirmation was not immediately available.
BNI topped the active trading list, with 26.5 million shares changing hands. It rose 75 rupiah to 1,775 rupiah.
One broker with a Japanese firm said expectations for its good 1996 results might have helped the strong performance.
Some analysts said prospect of further interest rate cut kept upbeat sentiment on banking stocks.
BNI, Lippo Bank, Bank International Indonesia and Bank Danamon were among the active banking stocks, brokers said.

Lippo Bank rose 13 percent to 2,825 rupiah on a volume of 7.8 million shares. Brokers said it was partly linked to a report that its floating rate certificates of deposit issue had been increased due to oversubscription.
Toll-road operator Citra Marga, conglomerate Bimantara Citra, Telkom and Indosat were also among the gainers.
Telkom closed at 4,225 rupiah after touching a high of 4,250 rupiah. Indosat was up 175 rupiah to 7,150 rupiah on 1.4 million shares. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
